clips.title: The story
paras: Mirror Lake Orchard is a quiet grove and cottage nestled on the southern banks of Mirror Lake in western Elwynn Forest. Once a peaceful homestead near Thunder Falls, it has fallen into the hands of Defias bandits who exploit the countryside while Stormwind's guards look elsewhere.

Tucked away near the cascading waters of Thunder Falls, Mirror Lake Orchard was once a productive farmstead benefiting from the clean waters of Mirror Lake. Today, the peaceful cottage sits overrun, claimed by opportunistic thieves and brigands flying the colors of the Defias Brotherhood. With the kingdom's military stretched thin and King Varian Wrynn missing, rural properties like this orchard have become easy pickings for outlaws looking to secure hideouts across the Elwynn countryside.
